source.author: Kalindi Charan Panigrahi
source.edition: Second edition, 2006, Cuttack Students Store; publisher's preface dates first edition to 1973
source.provenance: Original scan acquired through Odia Bibhaba; Srujanika digitization

content.question: What does Kalindi's autobiography say about writing, livelihood and Matira Manisha?

scope.reading: Team visually inspected PDF247–418, 172 consecutive scan pages: printed239–408 plus two backmatter pages. The range includes a third-party appendix, not172 pages of uninterrupted memoir.
scope.unread: Earlier printed1–238 are not covered by this reading; prior frontmatter/contents inspection remains separately recorded.
scope.method: Original Odia scan images read visually. No OCR-only adoption, whole-book reading or firsthand encounter with the author claimed.

findings.finding: He recalls a Rs40 prize for literary criticism and the encouragement of his teacher.
findings.limit: Literary prize, not a film fee or regular earnings.

findings.finding: Biswanath Kar published an essay despite disagreeing with its argument, adding a contrary editorial note and inviting more work.
findings.limit: Paraphrase; do not present recalled dialogue as a verbatim contemporary record.

findings.finding: Balakrushna Kar invited him to write for Saraswat Press's novel series within two months. He recalls writing Matira Manisha in that period and drawing characters from village experience.
findings.limit: Novel creation/publication, not the later film transaction.

findings.finding: He says his mother unknowingly entered his portrayal of the novel's principal elderly woman.
findings.limit: Do not extend this to film casting or adaptation fidelity; no character name supplied here.

findings.finding: At Bhanja Pradip he proposed paying Odia writers and artists, as English contributors were paid. He recalls acceptance and letters of thanks.
findings.limit: Periodical contributors, not his own fee, a stated rate, novel royalty or film payment.

findings.finding: He describes income from textbook writing, publicity and insurance work, with irregular commission receipts in the later account. AIR offered broader contact with listeners.
findings.limit: Different career periods; do not flatten into one salary, generalize prosperity or infer cinema income.

findings.locator: Printed357 / PDF365, first paragraph below conference heading
findings.finding: During prolonged illness he continued textbook and magazine-essay writing with a scribe's assistance.

adaptation_result.finding: No firsthand Matira Manisha film-rights or film-payment statement identified within the inspected range.
adaptation_result.not_absence_proof: Earlier printed1–238 remain unread; silence cannot establish nonpayment.
adaptation_result.reported_publication_rights: At printed277 he repeats what friends told him about publication rights amid ironic commentary. This is neither a signed assignment nor film-rights proof.
adaptation_result.back_cover: Film adaptation is mentioned in publisher backmatter, not in an author negotiation account.
adaptation_result.previous_amount: Retrospective Rs25,000 claim remains unverified; no change to its evidence status.

editorial_recommendation.profile: Use novel origin and the mother/character connection as a compact human passage.
editorial_recommendation.literature_and_screen: Use the periodical-pay recollection as a historical example of an author advocating payment; explicitly retain medium distinction.
editorial_recommendation.air_cuttack: His listener-contact account could deepen the existing radio connection without repeating a biography.
editorial_recommendation.avoid: Do not add all findings everywhere or create a new article merely for these excerpts.

remaining_queue.question: Integrate reviewed memoir findings if requested
remaining_queue.gate: Keep passages compact, cite printed pages and avoid repeating the same memoir material across articles.
